Name: Reentry Resource Center – San Jose (County of Santa Clara Office of Reentry Services)
Description: One-stop center for formerly incarcerated residents offering case triage, benefits enrollment, housing navigation, behavioral health & substance use referrals, peer support and legal screening.
Tags: case management; benefits; housing; mental health; legal screening; peer support
Eligibility Requirements: Adults formerly or currently incarcerated or under supervision

Name: Reentry Resource Center – Gilroy (County of Santa Clara ORS)
Description: Same comprehensive services as San Jose center available for South County residents.
Tags: case management; housing; health services; benefits; legal screening
Eligibility Requirements: Adults formerly incarcerated or under supervision

Name: Goodwill of Silicon Valley (at RRCs)
Description: Paid on‑the‑job training and employment linkage provided onsite at Reentry Resource Centers.
Eligibility Requirements: Justice-involved adults in Santa Clara County
Service Area (ZIP, City, County, State): San Jose & Gilroy, Santa Clara, CA

Name: Catholic Charities of Santa Clara County
Description: Vocational skills training, professional job search assistance, and housing/benefits referrals for justice-involved individuals.

Name: San Jose City College Peer Mentor Certification (via RRC)
Description: Free peer mentor certification course in drug and alcohol counseling offered at RRC for justice-involved adults.

Name: Pro Bono Project Silicon Valley (via RRC)
Description: Free civil legal advice and representation for reentry clients (family law, expungement, housing, benefits).
